comment: Reviewed license manifest for everything SceneMux distributes. This file is the
'reviewed' half of the license check: script/license-inventory.py cross-checks it
against Package.resolved and against the notice texts on disk, so the three can
never silently drift apart. Adding a dependency without adding it here fails the
check. See docs/legal/LICENSE_POLICY.md for how a license class is decided.
spm-pin    resolved by Swift Package Manager; must appear in Package.resolved
vendored   shipped inside another dependency; not an SPM pin of its own
in-repo    a local package committed to this repository
derivation inherited codebase this project is derived from

dependencies.name: WinMux
dependencies.usage: Direct upstream. SceneMux is derived from WinMux at baseline commit e0ad328e109cb6d2f86b1bdbc3aea9bf7bc5935e; its window engine is the foundation SceneMux builds on.

dependencies.name: AeroSpace
dependencies.usage: Ancestral upstream. WinMux is itself a derivative of AeroSpace, so AeroSpace's MIT terms flow through to SceneMux.

dependencies.name: ANTLR v4
dependencies.usage: Parser generator for the built-in shell-like configuration language. Its Antlr4Static runtime is statically linked into the app via the in-repo ShellParserGenerated package.

dependencies.name: HotKey
dependencies.usage: Swift wrapper around the macOS Carbon API for listening to global keyboard shortcuts.

dependencies.name: ISSoundAdditions
dependencies.usage: Convenience API for reading and changing the system output volume.

dependencies.name: MASShortcut
dependencies.usage: Keyboard-shortcut recorder control used by the settings UI.

dependencies.name: Sparkle
dependencies.usage: Application auto-update framework, including EdDSA signature verification of update archives.
dependencies.note: Automated scanners report NOASSERTION for Sparkle because its LICENSE is MIT text followed by an EXTERNAL LICENSES section. Reading it gives: Sparkle itself MIT; bsdiff/bspatch and SUSignatureVerifier.m BSD-2-Clause; sais-lite MIT; the portable Ed25519 implementation Zlib. Every component is permissive.

dependencies.name: swift-collections
dependencies.usage: Additional Swift collection types such as ordered and deque containers.

dependencies.name: TOMLKit
dependencies.usage: Swift wrapper over the tomlplusplus C++ TOML parser; reads the user configuration file.

dependencies.name: tomlplusplus
dependencies.usage: The actual TOML parser. Shipped as C++ sources inside TOMLKit rather than as a Swift Package Manager pin of its own, so it is recorded here manually.

dependencies.name: ShellParserGenerated
dependencies.usage: ANTLR-generated parser for the configuration language, committed to this repository as a local Swift package. Inherited from the WinMux baseline and covered by the same MIT terms.
